notes.title: 0.2 The Steam Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Steam Integration[/h3]
The Shroomlings is now available on Steam for both Mac and Windows. You can conveniently play at any time through Steam.
[h3]Steam Keys[/h3]
We’re now distributing unique Steam keys to a select group of trusted beta testers. With each update, we plan to gradually expand our testing group.
[h3]Match options and Basic User Interface[/h3]
We’ve introduced a new, intuitive UI that offers three match options:
    • Singleplayer – Battle against computer opponents in five difficulty levels.
    • Multiplayer (Friends) – Host a game to play with friends. You also can give your friends an economic advantage to balance the game if they’re not on your level yet.
    • Multiplayer (Online) – Use the matchmaking system to connect with a random player. Every other week, our servers will be available for several hours.
[h3]Graphic improvements[/h3]
    • All fighter Shroomlings now feature unique models and animations.
    • Camera view and "see-through effect by hovering" is improved for easier growing behind large structures.
    • Unique particle effects and projectiles for all fighter shroomlings and fighter structures.

[h2]New Game Mechanics[/h2]
    • Housing Space
You must now build Shelters and Huts to provide enough housing space for your Shroomling units.

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
[h3]Fighter Unit Changes[/h3]
    • Most fighter units have slower movement speed and shorter attack range, but they also cost less.
    • Thunder Wizard: Increased attack damage but reduced AoE radius.
    • Monorock: Faster attack speed but lower attack damage and reduced field of view.
    • Rammling: No longer attacks roots and nests.
[h3]Fighter Structure Changes[/h3]
    • All fighter structures have reduced attack range but deal more damage.
    • Mycelus Turret: Faster attack speed but lower attack damage.
    • Mycelus Tower: Now deals only single-target damage but has higher attack damage; also costs more spores.
    • Keratin Tower: Now deals AoE damage.
    • Mother Shroomling: Reduced attack range at all tiers, but gains AoE damage at Tier 3.
[h3]Economy Changes[/h3]
    • Hunter: Generates higher income but descaling occurs faster.
    • Foragers: Now generate less income.
    • Farm: Scales more slowly and has a slightly lower capacity.
    • Mother Shroomling: Generates less income.
    • Hut: Now available at Tier 1 (previously Tier 2).

notes.title: Version 0.2.690
notes.notes:
[b]Balancing changes[/b]

Fighter unit changes
- Almost all units have generally slower movement speed and less range
- Thunder wizard has more atk dmg but a smaller AoE radius
- Giant champion and rammling cost more
- Monorock has a faster atk speed but has less damage

Fighter structure changes:
- All fighter structures have less range
- All fighter structures have more damage
- Mycelus tower does only single-target damage, but a lot more atk dmg
- Mother shroomling also has less range on all tiers, but deals AoE damage on T3.

Eco changes:
- Farm scales slower, and has a lower cap
- Mothershroomling has less income
- Hunter has more income but a faster descaling
- Foragers have less income
